rules_edition: Daggerheart SRD 2.0 2026-08-25 + exact Veiled City content

features.name: Pack Pressure
features.reason: Native standard attack modifier from bound live Thralls in the target's actual zone; no guessed pairwise range.

features.name: Flashbang
features.reason: Native owner reaction and independent exact owner success choice; no automatic PC response.

features.name: Feedback
features.reason: Native visible owned-device use; owner-only Instinct 12 reaction with supported Stress capacity. No hidden use or Stress-overflow shortcut.

features.name: Local Mesh
features.reason: HR03 v2 bounded native alliance and same-zone Melee subset of Close; nonstacking defense Difficulty only. Unproved cross-zone range remains held.

features.name: Blood Rush
features.reason: Native after-damage Stress recovery; GM elects current position within Very Close. Other relocation stays reviewed.

features.name: Stack Formation
features.reason: Bounded source-pinned GM-owned Horde defense: +1 Difficulty at 4+ actual remaining HP; saved attack odds remain immutable.

features.name: Coordinated Volley
features.reason: Owner-authorized in-place house rule; shared native roll with independent owner defenses.

features.name: All Lanes Stop
features.reason: Native shared feature cost with independent owner reactions and sourced movement limits.

features.name: Many Deaths
features.reason: Explicit HR01 v1 only: actual causal PC Fear opportunity, Pack at 4+ remaining HP, native standard hit; extra Stress capacity and suppression prerequisites remain guarded.

features.name: Plausible Denial
features.reason: Exact source-pinned passive: campaign Veil Exposure 0–2 adds 1 Difficulty to attacks against this native actor.

features.name: Break the Pattern
features.reason: Feature type/timing is missing from authored content.

features.name: Command the Blood
features.reason: Bounded same-zone Presence 20 reaction; failed owner selects 2 Hope or 2 Stress. Command selection remains scoped review until a communicated bounded command and supported owner declaration/effect exist.

features.name: Consensus Pressure
features.reason: Exact source-pinned passive: campaign Veil Exposure 0–2 adds 2 Difficulty and 5–6 subtracts 1 Difficulty from attacks against this native actor.

features.name: Horde (3d8+8)
features.reason: HR11 remaining-vs-marked HP; exact Host changes standard damage at marked half, with native offer and damage proof.

features.name: Contingency Stack
features.reason: Automatic pinned native pre-damage defense; first actual Severe hit per actor/scene only, no new dice or PC effect.
